talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 23 solo PCPs winding down in Missouri; 1 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Saint Louis 63121) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.

**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Jasper County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 5 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~69,600 patients across 58 at-risk practices statewide.
